title: A plan before a migration.
subtitle: Format · root location · folder layout
steps: status and registry show the archives. --scan registers older indexes where needed.
upgrade --plan names each step, refusal, upload wait and disk-space cost. Scope it to a path, repo, or --all.

verify each upgraded repo. Check upload-status, then evict eligible uploaded copies.

details: The upgrade skill has no separate executable. It drives archive-icloud/icloud_archive.py and the same store, locks, registry and readers.
